Get Your Odoo API Key
1
Sign in to redoxyae.odoo.com.
2
Tap your avatar (top right) → Preferences / My Profile.
3
Click the Account Security tab.
4
Under Developer API Keys, click New API Key.
5
Enter your account password and copy the generated key.
